name: amp1_assistive
description: AMP1's assistive harness: the basic harness's perception without task priors and object editing for any embodiment, with or without a mobile base, plus grasping and placing routines (grasp and place proposals, planned picks and places, kinematics); waypoint motion stays available, and a robot with a base or a torso also has move_base and move_joints. The robot, its gripper and cameras are read from the observation.
bootstrap:
import robolab_harness as rh
rh._trace.HARNESS = "amp1_assistive"
ep = rh.connect(EPISODE_FILE, wait_ready_s=READY_TIMEOUT_S)

trace_kinds.harness.amp1_assistive.connect: the episode became ready (or connect failed): instruction, wait
trace_kinds.harness.amp1_assistive.candidates: grasps / places / check_grasp / check_place: the query, how many were feasible, the best, up to 8 feasible ids with their notes, and a failure code when none is
trace_kinds.harness.amp1_assistive.plan: an assist plan or a manual preview: kind, ok, plan_id, n_steps, error issues
trace_kinds.harness.amp1_assistive.execute: a motion (execute, run, lift, release, move, push, steps, move_to, gripper, hold, home, stop, move_joints, move_base): its reply and the observed state after it
trace_kinds.harness.amp1_assistive.verify: verify_grasp / pick_verified / place_verified: the verdict and every attempt, each failed one with a failure code and, when given, the chosen candidate's notes
trace_kinds.harness.amp1_assistive.objects: segment / define_object / forget_object / reperceive: the agent's edits to the scene
trace_kinds.harness.amp1_assistive.perceive: objects / object_points / object_at / object_at_pixel / pick: the perceived ids, or the points' shape
trace_kinds.harness.amp1_assistive.look: rgb / depth / cloud / render / views / render_plan / annotate / closeup / scene / fingers_view / camera: the call and its image's or array's shape, never the pixels
trace_kinds.harness.amp1_assistive.query: ik / ik_batch / check / check_batch / fk / robot: the kinematics query and its result
trace_kinds.harness.amp1_assistive.request: one HTTP request the SDK sent: method, path, status, latency_s, bytes, and stack, the public ep methods that sent it, outermost first
